prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one MINIMAL OUTLINE GRASS GLYPH for a professional UI toolbar. Simple flat 2D BLACK line art on a transparent background. Five elegant slightly curved grass strokes, central one tallest, all joined along one short straight baseline; only seven or fewer clean paths. Consistent medium rounded stroke, rounded joins; open spacious gaps. Icon should fill 80% of a square, centered, readable at 24px; use a 128x128 canvas if supported. Only pure opaque BLACK strokes, truly transparent empty pixels everywhere else. Crisp vector-like digital icon, not drawn with ink or brush. No textured strokes, noise, grey shading, plants rendering, color, three-dimensional volume, light, photo, ground, roots, frame, checkerboard, text or watermark.
